label: Date type spike
info: Spike: can the parquet node write a DATE column? Output in Sandbox/spike/ of the data lake. Delete the tab after the test.

name: [1] SPIKE: BUILD ROWS
info: STAGE 1 - one inject, one function: two small tables with numbers only (the first spike showed that the node reads text and Date objects as numbers: 2026-09-01 became 2026). A: a DATE column from a number of days since 1970-01-01. B: TIMESTAMP_MILLIS from epoch milliseconds, for a time of day (Excel day 1899-12-30, negative number) and for a date at midnight. Written to Sandbox/spike/ so the types and values can be read afterwards.
